# signoz_downtime_schedules (Data Source)

Lists all objects returned by the list API endpoint for this resource type. (`GET /api/v1/downtime_schedules`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Required/optional comments follow provider schema and SigNoz OpenAPI / Alertmanager where applicable.

data "signoz_downtime_schedules" "all" {} # no arguments

output "downtime_schedule_count" {
  value = length(data.signoz_downtime_schedules.all.schedules) # read-only
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `schedules` (Attributes List) Downtime schedules in the organization. Read-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))

<a id="nestedatt--schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules`

Read-Only:

- `alert_ids` (List of String) List of alert rule UUIDs affected by this schedule. Default: omitted (applies per SigNoz API semantics when unset).
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `created_by` (String) Identifier of the user or service that created the object. Read-only.
- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description. Default: omitted (empty string).
- `id` (String) SigNoz-assigned UUID. Read-only.
- `kind` (String) Schedule kind from the API. Read-only. Valid values: `fixed`, `recurring`.
- `name` (String) Schedule name (unique per organization). Used for data source lookup when `id` is not set.
- `schedule` (String) JSON schedule object (`AlertmanagertypesSchedule`). Required key: `timezone` (IANA name, e.g. `UTC`, `America/Chicago`). For a one-off window use `startTime` and `endTime` (RFC3339). For recurrence include `recurrence` with `startTime`, `duration`, and `repeatType` (`daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`). Optional `repeatOn` for weekly schedules: `sunday`, `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday`.
- `status` (String) Current schedule status from the API. Read-only. Valid values: `active`, `upcoming`, `expired`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
- `updated_by` (String) Identifier of the user or service that last updated the object. Read-only.
